recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the FHIR-14377 model while aligning the current build with the later reasonCode/reasonReference merge into Immunization.reason.
issue_request: FHIR-14377 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3 Immunization. It asked PHWG to separate reasons an immunization occurred from reasons it did not occur by adding statusReason for not-done, renaming the old Immunization.reason to reasonCode, adding reasonReference for Condition, Observation, and DiagnosticReport support, and binding the reason elements appropriately.
initial_application: The February 2018 source commit f451f3fc applied the Immunization changes without naming FHIR-14377 in the commit subject: it added statusReason with committee note #14377, renamed reason to reasonCode, added reasonReference, added status-reason search material, and updated examples/value sets. The current StructureDefinition still carries the #14377 committee note on statusReason.
additional_context: FHIR-14374 closed by reference to the FHIR-14377 resolution, and FHIR-17811 later refined the statusReason wording while preserving the performed-reason versus status-reason distinction. In current R6 source, reasonCode and reasonReference have intentionally been merged into the CodeableReference element Immunization.reason, with source/fhir.ini recording reasonCode -> reason.concept and reasonReference -> reason.reference. FHIR-54325 later updated statusReason for not-done and entered-in-error statuses but left the obsolete reasonCode wording in the comment.
reconciliation: Changed source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml so the Immunization.statusReason comment now says the reason for performing the immunization event is captured in Immunization.reason, not statusReason. Updated the matching resource-side text in source/immunization/immunization-event-mapping-exceptions.xml so the companion mapping-exception source remains consistent.
source_changes: source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml: changed the statusReason comment from obsolete reasonCode wording to Immunization.reason.
source/immunization/immunization-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: changed the matching resource-side Event mapping exception text to Immunization.reason.
